title: Kurt's forgotten childhood in gifted and talented program

tellings.quote:
I I have no idea. I don't remember a
single part of it.

plain: As a boy in New Jersey, a guest named Kurt Metzger was placed in a gifted and talented school programme, and today he says he remembers none of it. He says so himself, in an episode about Jeffrey Epstein and the idea of a global satanic cabal: "I don't remember a single part of it." The blank is raised as something strange, as if whatever happened in that programme had been wiped from his memory.
